name: 19151 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19151 (Philadelphia) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19151 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19151 (Philadelphia) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
